commits.message: audit: append order events to a local audit log
commits.author: j.silva@example.com

files.app/audit.py:
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone

AUDIT_LOG = os.environ.get("ORDERS_AUDIT_LOG", "/var/log/orders/audit.jsonl")


def record(event: str, subject_id: str):
    line = {"ts": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "event": event, "subject": subject_id}
    with open(AUDIT_LOG, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps(line) + "\n")

commits.message: exports: write atomically via temp file and rename
commits.author: p.nair@example.com

app/exports.py:
import os
import os
import tempfile
    with open(path, "w", newline="") as fh:
        writer = csv.writer(fh)
        writer.writerow(["id", "status", "total", "created_at"])
        for o in orders:
            writer.writerow([o["id"], o["status"], o["total"], o["created_at"]])
    return path
    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", dir=os.path.dirname(path), suffix=".tmp", delete=False, newline="")
    writer = csv.writer(tmp)
    writer.writerow(["id", "status", "total", "created_at"])
    for o in orders:
        writer.writerow([o["id"], o["status"], o["total"], o["created_at"]])
    tmp.flush()
    os.replace(tmp.name, path)
    return path
